title: Music Utilities
description: Adds soundtrack-aware music commands and a persistent now-playing popup for Minecraft music.
body:
![Mod Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16463aced46596ef86311bd7ac23a94a3cca08ad.png)

Music Utilities is a mod that significantly improves your Minecraft music experience by adding commands to toggle a music menu, music notifications, artist profiles, and more.

The mod implements all of these features while keeping the vanilla feel, including a toggleable vanilla jukebox-like music notification.

## **💡 Key Features:**
- Music Notifications (Toast)
- Music Notifications (Now Playing)
- Music GUI Menu
- Music Toggle/Play Commands
- Music Artist Profiles

## **📖 Downloading Instructions:**
- Download the version you prefer.
- Click the Windows button on the bottom left-hand corner/middle.
- Type %appdata% into the textbox and then click enter.
- Find and open the folder called ".minecraft".
- Open the mods folder and put the mod in there!
